items.rationale: Contested call, surfaced rather than settled. Two independent cohorts show the T allele under-represented among the longest-lived in the same direction, but neither result is significant. The state vocabulary offers no suggestive value, so risk is the closest available label for the C/T row and the hedge is carried by stat_significance=suggestive and by the conclusion text; C/C is neutral. Reading C/T as neutral is equally defensible on p=0.07; a reviewer should decide. Not derived from any source that later checks it. Note this record reads as unbound in review_queue: the override key carries no genotype, so a per-genotype column cannot bind. Nobody edited the cell. No source states a weight; the column is authored by definition. Set deliberately near zero rather than proportional to the published odds ratio (3.58), because neither supporting study reached significance (p=0.074 and p=0.073) and Hirvonen report 28.4% power. The magnitude encodes confidence in the association, not its effect size. A curator who disagrees should change it; the reasoning is in weighting: in module_spec.yaml.
